name: North Macedonia

fees.name: Short-stay visa (type C, up to 90 days) - covers tourism and business visits
fees.applies: all nationalities requiring a visa; EUR 35 for children aged 6-12
fees.notes: Fee per Law on Administrative Fees, Tariff No. 135. North Macedonia is not a Schengen member but follows the Schengen-style EUR 60 short-stay fee. Holders of valid multiple-entry Schengen (C) visas may enter without a Macedonian visa for short stays.

fees.name: Transit visa (type C, up to 5 days)
fees.applies: all nationalities requiring a visa; EUR 35 for children aged 6-12
fees.notes: Transit is issued as a C visa at the same EUR 60 fee.

fees.name: Business visit (issued as short-stay type C visa)
fees.notes: No separate business visa category; business visits use the C visa. Long-stay D visa (work/study/family) is EUR 70 but is out of scope as a residence-track visa.

vfs.note: Applications are lodged directly at diplomatic-consular missions of North Macedonia; no VFS Global/TLScontact/BLS outsourcing for inbound visas. (VFS centres in Skopje serve outbound applicants to Canada/UK etc., not visas TO North Macedonia.)

free_visa_notes: No e-visa, eTA, or visa-on-arrival regime. Many nationalities (EU, USA, GBR, CAN, and others) enter visa-free; holders of valid multiple-entry Schengen C visas may also enter visa-free for short stays. Reduced fee of EUR 35 applies to children aged 6-12; no published nationality-based reciprocity fee schedule.
